name: Marco Rossi
title: Junior NLP Engineer
summary: A highly motivated Junior NLP Engineer with a strong foundation in machine learning and natural language processing techniques. Possesses hands-on experience in developing and deploying NLP models for various applications, eager to contribute to innovative projects.

bullets: Developed and optimized text classification models for customer feedback, improving accuracy by 15% using Python and scikit-learn.
Implemented a sentiment analysis pipeline for social media data, processing over 10,000 posts daily with 90% precision.
Contributed to the development of a Named Entity Recognition (NER) system for legal documents, reducing manual annotation time by 20%.
Assisted in data preprocessing and feature engineering for various NLP tasks, handling datasets up to 500,000 entries.
Researched and experimented with different transformer models using PyTorch, achieving a 5% performance boost on a text summarization task.
Wrote Python scripts to automate data collection and cleaning, reducing preparation time by an estimated 30 hours per project.
Supported a research project on conversational AI, contributing to the development of a chatbot prototype.
Analyzed linguistic patterns in large text corpora (over 1 million words) using NLTK to identify key themes.
